theme: Original Primeval Dragons - the Elder Dragons and their Primeval heirs (Phase 6 Pilot 2)
status: UNAPPROVED PROPOSAL - awaiting Cory's review; not approved, not locked, not certified

tier_definitions.DIRECT_DEPICTION: Official Wizards story captions this exact art at the event.
tier_definitions.CANON_REFERENCE: Card is the named character/event, or its printed text or an official article ties it to the Elder/Primeval Dragon canon.
tier_definitions.LORE_INSPIRED: Named or thematic link only; no scene or event asserted.
tier_definitions.MECHANICAL_SYMBOL: Included for function; no story claim.

cards.name: The Ur-Dragon
cards.why: The five-colour progenitor dragon. Invasion-era Attendant flavor calls each Primeval a part of 'the ur-dragon'. That this Commander 2017 card is the same being is a thematic link, not an asserted canon identity.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas
cards.beat: I. The Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the war Bolas started
cards.why: The original Elder Dragon card. In the Chronicle he provokes the dragon clans, and Wizards credits him with instigating the Elder Dragon War.

cards.beat: I. The Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the war Bolas started
cards.why: Core Set 2019 Elder Dragon reprint cycle: Bolas as a Grixis Elder Dragon.

printing.type_line: Legendary Creature — Elder Dragon // Legendary Planeswalker — Bolas
